{{ relative_time(motions[0].last_changed) }} ago{% else %}No motion{% endif %}

template.presetSelected: A preset chip is selected only while templateString equals its template, character for character. A tap writes the preset's template.
template.write: The editor writes templateString on every change, as typed: no trim, an emptied editor writes "", the key is never removed. Each opening of the phone's editor sheet is one undo step.
template.reset: The Template task has no reset and no modified dot.

richText.rule: Every marker becomes an icon; the text between markers stays text. Inside a marker the words split on whitespace: the first word is the symbol, the first later word starting color: (any case) gives the color, an empty color is none. A marker with no word stays as literal text.
richText.colorRule: A color is one of colorNames (any case), else 3, 6 or 8 hex digits with or without #, 8 being RRGGBBAA. Anything else is no color: the icon takes the text color.

watch.draws: Only the rendered text, in the tile color: no icon, no label, no badges, whatever icon, customLabel and showLabel say.
watch.alignment: Centered when the text has one line, else leading.
watch.empty: An empty or absent templateString draws the add's icon at 40% in the tile color.
watch.error: A failed render draws a yellow exclamationmark.triangle.

add.musicHubSpeakerIds: Every media_player whose supported_features has groupingBit, sorted by entity id; [] when there is none.
add.ids: Two new ids: the entity id's UUID first, then the tile's id.

rules.open: Opening the Music task writes nothing. Only the add fills the speaker list.
rules.albumArt: showAlbumArt is written true or false, never removed.
rules.speakersAdd: Add Speaker lists the players with groupingBit. New picks are appended in the order given, an id already listed is skipped; unpicking removes nothing.
rules.speakerRemove: The id leaves musicHubSpeakerIds (the last one leaves []) and every preset; presets stay even when emptied.
rules.speakerMove: A dragged speaker lands at the place of the row it is dropped on.
rules.presetAdd: Add Preset shows while there are fewer than maxPresets presets and the hub lists minSpeakersForPresets or more speakers. It appends {id, name, speakerIds: []}: id a new upper case UUID, name presetName with n the count plus one (a name can repeat after a delete).
rules.presetName: The name as typed, no trim, "" allowed.
rules.presetToggle: A speaker's row in an open preset (one row per hub speaker, in hub order) appends the id when it is not in the preset, else removes it; the order is tap order.
rules.presetMove: A dragged preset lands at the place of the row it is dropped on.
rules.reset: The Music task has no reset.
rules.undo: Every write is one undo step.

replySpeakers.label: Choose Speakers

assist.watchSpeakerNote: Replies are spoken locally from Apple Watch. Home Assistant speaker targets and voice engine are not used.
rows: Reply Speaker (assistSpeakTargetMode), only in Speak Reply.

words.chooseSpeakersEmptyHint: Pick at least one Home Assistant speaker device (or speaker group) for this tile.

words.firstUseSetup: First use setup: when the Apple Watch typing screen appears, tap the bottom-right button, choose Mic, then tap Done. After that, later taps will default to mic listening.

assist.hiddenRows: A hidden row keeps its key: leaving Speak Reply or Choose Speakers removes nothing.
assist.replyOutputMode: A stored assistReplyOutputMode overrides Assist Mode and Reply Speaker on the watch. The edits in removedBy remove it; nothing sets it.

agent.help: Pick a conversation agent such as an LLM-backed assistant. Default uses Home Assistant's normal Assist route.
agent.write: A pick is written trimmed; Clear and Use Default Assistant remove assistAgentId.

add.color: The page theme's role color, as tile-defaults.json domains.speak_message; its gradient form on a gradient page.
add.saveWarning: The add's Choose Speakers with no speakers warns on the next save (checks); when the catalog's voice lists default speakers, the warning can name that fallback.

outputs.label: Apple Watch
outputs.help: Speaks directly from the Apple Watch speaker.

outputs.label: Choose Speakers
outputs.help: Uses this tile's selected speakers and TTS engine. Falls back to the global defaults when nothing is selected.

outputs.label: Choose on Watch
outputs.help: Prompts on watch from this tile's configured speaker list.

speak.watchSpeakerNote: Messages are spoken locally from Apple Watch. Home Assistant speaker targets and voice engine are not used.

warnings.chooseEachTimeEmptyList: Choose at least one Home Assistant speaker to show on watch for this tile.
warnings.chooseEachTimeNoEngine: Set a voice engine for this tile. The watch will ask which Home speaker to use each time.
warnings.rule: Under Choose on Watch: the first while the watch list is empty, the second while neither the tile nor the voice defaults have an engine.

volume.write: Rounded to a whole percent, then clamped to min...max. A stored value reads clamped; one undo step per slider change.

volumeModes.label: Keep Current
volumeModes.detail: Uses each target speaker's current volume.

volumeModes.label: Set for Message + Restore
volumeModes.detail: Sets the selected volume before speaking, then restores previous volume after the message.

volumeModes.label: Set and Keep
volumeModes.detail: Sets the selected volume before speaking and leaves it there.

speakers.write: A speaker sheet's Done writes the picks sorted by id, without repeats; none removes the key.
speakers.countSummary: Assist's row: "None selected", "1 selected", "{n} selected". The default speakers never count.
speakers.listSummary: Speak's rows: "None selected", else the object ids with _ as spaces in Foundation's capitalized, joined with ", ". The panel shows friendly names instead.

engine.help: Home Assistant voice engine used for this tile (for example: Google Translate, Piper, Nabu Casa TTS).
engine.write: A pick is written trimmed; Use Default Engine (shown while the tile has an engine) removes the key.
engine.display: The tile's engine, else the voice default engine, by name; else "Not set" in the warning color.

lists.engines: Every tts. state named by its friendly_name (else the object id with _ as spaces, capitalized), plus tts.<platform> for every tts service named <platform>_say that is not listed yet, named the same way. tts.cloud only while Home Assistant Cloud's status says logged_in true and cloud "connected"; a failed status call drops it. Sorted by name ignoring case, then by id.
lists.cloudRule: Home Assistant Cloud counts as connected only when its status has logged_in exactly true and cloud exactly "connected". A failed call is not connected.
lists.speakers: Every media_player: announce bit first, then by name ignoring case.
lists.musicHubSpeakers: Every media_player with musicHub.groupingBit, sorted by entity id.
lists.failed: A list that does not load shows the stored id as the only choice; nothing blocks.

voice.defaults: The catalog's voice object (defaultAssistAgentId, defaultSpeakers, defaultTTSEngine, each left out when blank) is what a tile falls back to. No voice key: an older phone. {}: the phone has no defaults.

checks.speak: A speak_message. tile in configuredSpeakers with no speakMessageTargetSpeakerIds, or in chooseEachTime with no speakMessageChooseListSpeakerIds (an absent speakMessageOutputMode is watchSpeaker).
checks.assist: An assist.voice_hub tile in Speak Reply (assistPrimaryAction assistAndSpeakReply; absent and speakOnly read assistOnly) with Choose Speakers (assistSpeakTargetMode configuredSpeakers) and no assistTargetSpeakerIds.
checks.flow: Warnings, never refusals: before a save, one dialog per check that finds a tile (Speak first, then Assist), naming the tiles, with Save anyway and Cancel.

pointControl.rule: Both switches are keys of the behavior document, not tile keys: one value for every point control tile, outside the page's Save and undo. The page editor shows them read only (absent reads Off) with "Change in Rooms": the panel's Rooms editor and the phone change them, with the rooms and their targets. Capturing a heading with the watch compass stays on the phone.
pointControl.reset: The Pointer task writes no tile key and has no reset.

webhookInbox.roundTrip: No add and no task in the panel: a webhook_inbox. tile is carried as it is, entityId never rewritten. Every common task works on it.
webhookInbox.setUpLine: Webhook inbox. Set up on the iPhone.
webhookInbox.topicRule: The part after webhook_inbox.; empty or all means every topic ("All topics"), anything else is "#<topic>".
webhookInbox.labelRule: The watch draws customLabel when it is set (even empty), else "#<topic>", else "Inbox".

resets.data: Reset Data on an assist or speak tile writes resets.data of tile-special.json, which removes assistReplyOutputMode too.
